## Findings refused / left as they are
- Unit 7 ውእ ፡ ቱ as two tokens: kept as printed (conventions: never retype; wordspace tokenizes). Flag for gloss.json author: known-forms `ቱ` ("final syllable of እሙንቱ") is wrong for this chapter; here ውእ + ቱ = ውእቱ 'he, it is'.
- Unit 1 "so David also said": kept; the ወበከመ…ወዳዊትኒ comparison is explained in the note.
- Unit 6/15 "Lord" for እግዚኦ/እግዚአብሔር: kept, house rendering.
- "for ever and ever" for ለዓለመ ዓለም: kept as the standard doxology rendering, literal sense given in the note.
- Unit 16 "all his matters": awkward English but matches house ነገር 'matter'; antecedent of "his" unclear, left.
- Whether ኰነነ ይኰንን/ይኴንን differ in stem (D vs G) cannot be settled without Dillmann (?); left unexplained.
- ሰረረ, ቀላየ, ሓውርት, ክመ, ጥልቀት, አጠየቀ, ፄዊወከ stay hedged; no better reading without the lexicon.
- Novel-forms entries all empty; that is gloss.json's task, not touched. Items for that author: ወፂእየ (root ወ, not 'and'), ተጽዕነ (known-forms 'was loaded'; here 'was borne/rode (?)'), መኳንንት ('nobles'), ጥልቀት ('defect (?)'), ቱ.
